url.description: Target to probe: http://, https://, or tcp://host:port for a plain TCP dial check.

basic_auth_secret.description: secret_ref to a "username:password" pair, resolved by the core before the adapter is spawned. Optional — omit for unauthenticated targets.

tls_expiry_warn_days.description: Only meaningful for https:// targets — days-remaining threshold below which the tls.cert_expiry check reports warn instead of ok.
